title: Integral closure commutes with finite products
statement: Let $R_i\to S_i$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings for $i=1,\dots,n$, let $R=\prod_iR_i$ and $S=\prod_iS_i$, and let $S_i'\subseteq S_i$ be the subring of elements integral over $R_i$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Then the subring of $S$ consisting of elements integral over $R$ is exactly $\prod_iS_i'$. In particular, $R$ is integrally closed in $S$ if and only if each $R_i$ is integrally closed in $S_i$.
